ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% of the visible fluke surface consists of low-intensity (black) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to sparse, localized points and a small basal patch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black mapping across both lobes. A localized high-contrast white patch is visible at the inferior-medial base of the left lobe. Discrete high-intensity white point-clusters are scattered across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch separating the lobes with a defined vertex and symmetrical inward slopes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire superior boundary. Multiple jagged peaks and non-uniform valleys are present, particularly concentrated on the medial half of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch leading into a convex curvature toward the distal tips; the left tip is more acutely tapered and elongated than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (approximately 2-8 pixels in diameter) on the distal surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small white focal lesions or sessile organisms (barnacle attachments) on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke exhibits near-total black pigmentation across the visible ventral surface, a characteristic of 'Type 4' or 'Type 5' pigmentation patterns in this species.
